description: This file implements a text box UI component with functions for displaying and scrolling through text within a dialog box, primarily used in a console-based user interface such as the Linux kernel configuration. It includes functions for navigating, rendering, and interacting with multiline text in a windowed environment.

methods.name: int dialog_textbox(const char * title,const char * tbuf,int initial_height,int initial_width,int * _vscroll,int * _hscroll,int (* extra_key_cb)(int,size_t,size_t,void *),void * data)
methods.description: Displays a text box dialog with navigational controls, handling user input to scroll and exit.

methods.name: void back_lines(int n)
methods.description: Scrolls back 'n' lines within the text buffer.

methods.name: char * get_line(void)
methods.description: Retrieves the current line from the buffer and advances the pointer.

methods.name: void print_line(WINDOW * win,int row,int width)
methods.description: Renders a single line of text onto the window, applying horizontal scroll.

methods.name: void print_page(WINDOW * win,int height,int width)
methods.description: Displays a page of text consisting of multiple lines.

methods.name: void print_position(WINDOW * win)
methods.description: Displays the current scroll position as a percentage.

methods.name: void refresh_text_box(WINDOW * dialog,WINDOW * box,int boxh,int boxw,int cur_y,int cur_x)
methods.description: Refreshes the display content of the text box window based on current scroll position.

methods.name: draw_shadow
methods.description: Draws a shadow effect around the dialog window (assumed to be implemented elsewhere).

methods.name: draw_box
methods.description: Draws borders around the dialog window (assumed to be implemented elsewhere).

methods.name: print_title
methods.description: Displays the title in the dialog header (assumed to be implemented elsewhere).

methods.name: print_button
methods.description: Displays a button label in the dialog footer (assumed to be implemented elsewhere).

methods.name: on_key_esc
methods.description: Handles ESC key actions, possibly implemented to determine if ESC was pressed.

methods.name: on_key_resize
methods.description: Handles terminal resize events (likely adjusts window layout).
